metadata.description: TCM monitoring template aligned with CISA SCuBA baseline for Exchange Online. Covers email authentication (DKIM), anti-phishing, anti-spam, safe links, safe attachments, transport rules, and organization config.
metadata.license: Portions adapted from CISA SCuBA SCBs (TLP:CLEAR). See URL for full license terms.

controls.title: Automatic forwarding to external domains SHALL be disabled
controls.guidance: Remote domains 'Default' SHALL have automatic forwarding disabled. TCM monitors the OrganizationConfig and remote domain settings for drift that may re-enable auto-forwarding.

controls.title: DKIM SHOULD be enabled for all domains
controls.guidance: DKIM signing SHALL be enabled for all custom domains. TCM monitors the DkimSigningConfig Enabled property — drift means DKIM may be disabled.

controls.title: SMTP AUTH SHALL be disabled
controls.guidance: SMTP AUTH SHALL be disabled at the organization level. Modern email clients do not need it and MFA cannot be enforced when using SMTP AUTH. Monitor OrganizationConfig for changes.

controls.title: Contact folders SHALL NOT be shared with all domains
controls.guidance: Sharing policies SHALL NOT share contact folders with all domains. TCM monitors organization-level sharing settings for drift.

controls.title: Calendar details SHALL NOT be shared with all domains
controls.guidance: Sharing policies SHALL NOT share calendar details with all domains. TCM monitors organization-level sharing settings for drift.

controls.title: External sender warnings SHALL be implemented
controls.guidance: A mail flow (transport) rule SHALL prepend external sender warnings (e.g. '[External]') to the subject of emails from outside the organization. TCM monitors transport rules for drift that may disable this warning.

controls.title: Impersonation protection checks SHOULD be used
controls.guidance: Anti-phishing policies SHOULD have impersonation protection enabled. TCM monitors AntiPhishPolicy settings — drift may weaken impersonation detection.

controls.title: AI-based phishing detection (Mailbox Intelligence) SHOULD be enabled
controls.guidance: Anti-phishing policies SHOULD enable Mailbox Intelligence for AI-based phishing detection. TCM monitors AntiPhishPolicy for drift on intelligence settings.

controls.title: IP allow lists SHOULD NOT be created
controls.guidance: IP allow lists bypass spam filtering and sender authentication. TCM monitors HostedContentFilterPolicy for drift that may add IPs to allow lists.

controls.title: Safe lists SHOULD NOT be enabled
controls.guidance: Safe lists bypass spam filtering. TCM monitors HostedContentFilterPolicy for drift that may enable safe lists.

controls.title: Mailbox auditing SHALL be enabled
controls.guidance: Mailbox auditing SHALL be enabled at the organization level. TCM monitors OrganizationConfig AuditDisabled property — drift to 'true' means auditing was disabled.

controls.title: Allowed domains SHALL NOT be added to anti-spam policies
controls.guidance: Adding allowed domains (like office.com) to anti-spam policies bypasses filtering for many unknown users. TCM monitors HostedContentFilterPolicy for drift.

controls.title: URL comparison with a block-list SHOULD be enabled
controls.guidance: Safe Links SHOULD scan URLs against a block list. TCM monitors SafeLinksPolicy for drift that may disable URL scanning.

controls.title: Direct download links SHOULD be scanned for malware
controls.guidance: Safe Links SHOULD scan direct download links in real-time. TCM monitors SafeLinksPolicy for drift on file scanning settings.
